title: Inspect engineering definitions and their rationale
description: Engineers, reviewers, and engineering agents can inspect retained engineering definitions and their applicable recorded decision rationale in a selected model state, so they can understand the current engineering meaning and its basis without the originating conversation or replaying Changes.

includes: Select an engineering entity by its stable identity within one governed project model.
Obtain and understand its retained current definition and associated recorded decision rationale.
Recognize the selected subject and state, definition completeness, and gaps in the associated reasoning.
excludes: General full-text search, graph impact analysis, federated models, or a particular user interface.
Reconstructing historical baselines or treating displayed reasoning as evidence of requirement satisfaction.

sources.basis: IR-001 establishes the durable capability to inspect current engineering knowledge; SR-001, SR-002, SR-004, and SR-005 define its initial retention, identity, understanding, and rationale obligations.
Apply the user-selected clarity and naming rule to this existing asset; refine its name and explanation without changing its identity, capability scope, or typed relationships.
